About Roman Burke: We are a full-service dental practice committed to providing exceptional care in a comfortable environment. Our team of experienced professionals uses state-of-the-art technology to ensure the highest quality of dental care.

Roman Burke offers a wide range of services including: Pediatric Dentistry, Preventive Care, TMJ Treatment, Oral Surgery, Orthodontics, Endodontics, Cosmetic Dentistry, Dental Implants, Sedation Dentistry, Periodontics, General Dentistry, Emergency Dental Care, Sleep Apnea Treatment.

Roman Burke accepts the following insurance types: PPO, Medicaid, Tricare (Military Insurance), HMO, MetLife, Delta Dental, Cigna, United Healthcare, Medicare, Guardian, Aetna, CHIP (Children's Health Insurance Program).

Regarding insurance verification: We verify insurance coverage before appointments and can provide estimated costs. Please have your insurance card ready when scheduling. We'll need the subscriber's name, ID number, and group number.
Common insurance question: Coverage verification. Answer: We can verify your coverage before treatment.
Common insurance question: Pre authorization. Answer: Some procedures may require pre-authorization.
Common insurance question: Out of network. Answer: We may offer out-of-network benefits.
Common insurance question: Annual maximums. Answer: We track your insurance usage and benefits.
Common insurance question: Coordination of benefits. Answer: We can help coordinate between multiple insurance plans.

Roman Burke accepts these payment methods: Debit Cards, Personal Checks, Credit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), HSA/FSA Cards, Cash, Wells Fargo Health Advantage, CareCredit, Insurance, Payment Plans.

CareCredit financing is available at Roman Burke. Description: Special healthcare financing with deferred interest. Application: Can apply in office or online. Terms: Various payment terms available from 6-24 months.

In-house payment plans are offered at Roman Burke. Description: Custom payment plans for qualifying patients. Terms: Flexible monthly payments. Requirements: Valid ID and credit check may be required.

New patient appointments at Roman Burke typically last 90 minutes. They include: Treatment plan discussion, Cleaning (if time permits), Full set of x-rays, Comprehensive exam. Requirements: Bring ID and insurance card, Arrive 15 minutes early, List of current medications, Complete medical history form.
Routine dental cleanings at Roman Burke are 60 minutes long and recommended Every 6 months. They include: Professional cleaning, Oral cancer screening, Exam by dentist, X-rays (if due).

For emergencies, Roman Burke offers Same-day appointments for emergencies. Qualifying conditions include: Severe swelling, Bleeding that won't stop, Broken or chipped tooth, Severe tooth pain, Dental trauma, Lost filling or crown.
Appointments at Roman Burke can be booked via: Virtual assistant, Phone, Mobile app, Online portal.
Cancellation policy for Roman Burke: 24 hours notice is required. A fee May apply for late cancellations. Emergency situations considered.
Appointment reminders from Roman Burke are sent via Phone call, Text message, Email at 1 week before, 2 days before, Day of appointment.

Preparing for your first visit to Roman Burke: List of medications, X-rays (if available from previous dentist), Bring insurance card, Previous dental records (if available), Arrive 15 minutes early, Bring valid ID, Complete medical history. What to expect during your first visit: Review of medical history, Comprehensive examination, Financial consultation, Meeting with dental team, Treatment plan discussion, X-rays as needed.
About Cleaning procedure: Professional removal of plaque and tartar. Duration: 30-60 minutes. Frequency: Every 6 months. Preparation: No special preparation needed.

About Fillings procedure: Repair of cavities or tooth decay. Duration: 30-60 minutes. Preparation: No special preparation needed. Types include: Composite (tooth-colored), Amalgam (silver). Aftercare: Wait to eat until numbness subsides, May experience temporary sensitivity, Avoid very hot or cold foods.

About Root Canal procedure: Treatment of infected tooth pulp. Duration: 90 minutes to 2 hours. Preparation: No special preparation needed. Steps: Removal of infected tissue, Local anesthesia, Cleaning and sealing, Crown placement (usually separate visit). Aftercare: Avoid chewing on treated tooth, Return for permanent crown, Take prescribed medications.

About Crowns procedure: Cap to cover damaged tooth. Duration: Two visits: 90 minutes each. Preparation: No special preparation needed. Process: Second visit: Permanent crown placement, First visit: Preparation and temporary crown. Care Instructions: Regular checkups required, Avoid sticky foods with temporary crown, Maintain good oral hygiene.
General post-treatment care guidelines for Roman Burke: Contact office if issues arise, Take medications as prescribed, Follow specific aftercare instructions, Maintain good oral hygiene.

For pain management after treatment at Roman Burke: Normal symptoms include Slight swelling, Mild discomfort, Temporary sensitivity. Call the office if you experience: Excessive bleeding, Fever, Reaction to medication, Swelling that worsens, Severe pain.

COVID-19 protocols at Roman Burke include: Social distancing, Enhanced sterilization, PPE requirements, Health screening questions, Temperature checks. When visiting, expect: Arrive with mask, Hand sanitization required, Wait in car until appointment, Reduced waiting room capacity.
Privacy policy at Roman Burke: HIPAA compliance is 'Strict adherence to privacy laws'. Information sharing: 'Only with written consent'. Records access: 'Available upon written request'.
Accessibility at Roman Burke includes: Wheelchair accessible, Handicap parking, Ground floor location, Wide doorways. Special needs accommodations are 'Accommodations available upon request'.

General FAQs for Roman Burke: Parking: Free parking available in front of building. WiFi: Complimentary WiFi in waiting room. Children: Children welcome; play area available. Languages spoken: Spanish, Other languages via interpreter, English.

Clinical FAQs for Roman Burke: X-ray frequency: Based on dental history and needs. Importance of cleaning: Prevents cavities and gum disease. Fluoride use: Safe and recommended for cavity prevention. Sealants: Recommended for children's molars.

Insurance & Billing FAQs for Roman Burke: Claims filing: We file all insurance claims. Payment timing: Due at time of service. Statements: Monthly billing statements. Insurance maximums: We track your annual benefits.

Service offered: Dental Crowns. Description: Full coverage restoration of damaged teeth. Types/Options: Porcelain, Ceramic, Porcelain-fused-to-metal, Gold, Stainless Steel (primarily for children). Procedure Time: Two visits: preparation and placement.

Service offered: Dental Bridges. Description: Replace missing teeth with artificial ones. Types/Options: Traditional Bridge, Cantilever Bridge, Maryland Bridge, Implant-supported Bridge. Duration: 5-15 years with proper care.

Service offered: Dentures. Description: Removable replacements for missing teeth. Types/Options: Complete Dentures, Partial Dentures, Immediate Dentures, Implant-supported Dentures. Service offered: Root Canal Therapy. Description: Treatment of tooth pulp and root issues. Types/Options: Standard Root Canal, Retreatment, Apicoectomy, Pulp Capping.
Service offered: Gum Disease Treatment. Description: Treatment of gum disease and related issues. Types/Options: Deep Cleaning, Gum Surgery, Bone Grafting, Gum Grafting, Laser Therapy.

Rate limiting policy: If multiple calls are made in a short time (3 calls), your number might be temporarily blocked for 30 minutes. Message: 'We've noticed multiple calls in a short time. To ensure fair access, your number is temporarily blocked for 30 minutes. Please try again later.'.

Appointment request limit: You are allowed 5 appointment requests per day. Message: 'You've reached the daily limit of 5 appointment requests. Please try again tomorrow or contact the office for further assistance.'.

Reschedule request limit: You can reschedule an appointment 1 time per day. Message: 'You've already rescheduled an appointment today. To maintain fairness, rescheduling is limited to once per day. Please try again tomorrow.'.

If the virtual assistant cannot help, the frustrating user call ending message is: 'It seems like your requests are outside my expertise. I'm here to assist with dental-related inquiries. If you need help with appointments or services, feel free to ask. Otherwise, I'll need to end this call now. Have a great day!'.

If a session is inactive for 30 seconds, the call ending message is: 'It looks like you're away. I'll go ahead and end this call now. If you need any assistance, feel free to call back. Have a great day!'.

Prohibited topics for discussion by the virtual assistant include: medical_advice, diagnosis, treatment_recommendations, medication_advice, personal_health_information.
